description: Provision a Google Cloud Dataflow DataflowJob via Config Connector. Fields mirror the dataflow.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 DataflowJob spec.

additionalExperiments.description: List of experiments that should be used by the job. An example value is ["enable_stackdriver_agent_metrics"].

enableStreamingEngine.description: Indicates if the job should use the streaming engine feature.

ipConfiguration.description: The configuration for VM IPs. Options are "WORKER_IP_PUBLIC" or "WORKER_IP_PRIVATE".

kmsKeyRef.description: The name for the Cloud KMS key for the job. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed KMSCryptoKey. Should be in the format `projects/[kms_project_id]/locations/[region]/keyRings/[key_ring_id]/cryptoKeys/[key]`.

machineType.description: The machine type to use for the job.

maxWorkers.description: Immutable. The number of workers permitted to work on the job. More workers may improve processing speed at additional cost.

networkRef.description: ComputeNetworkRef is a reference to a GCP ComputeNetwork. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeNetwork resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/networks/{{networkID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeNetwork resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeNetwork resource.

parameters.description: Key/Value pairs to be passed to the Dataflow job (as used in the template).

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

region.description: Immutable. The region in which the created job should run.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

serviceAccountRef.description: Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

subnetworkRef.description: ComputeSubnetworkRef is a reference to a GCP ComputeSubnetwork. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeSubnetwork resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/regions/{{region}}/subnetworks/{{subnetworkID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeSubnetwork resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeSubnetwork resource.

tempGcsLocation.description: A writeable location on Google Cloud Storage for the Dataflow job to dump its temporary data.

templateGcsPath.description: The Google Cloud Storage path to the Dataflow job template.

transformNameMapping.description: Only applicable when updating a pipeline. Map of transform name prefixes of the job to be replaced with the corresponding name prefixes of the new job.

zone.description: Immutable. The zone in which the created job should run. If it is not provided, the provider zone is used.

title: GCP Dataflow DataflowJob
